craft_notes: Sthāyin: seal — dread then decree. Rows: verdict line-final. Rejected: softening ghore — killed: dread is the doctrine's hinge. Read aloud: drop then decree.

lines: both sink to dreadful hell. Hold, then, to this stance.
l4.sanskrit_cite: dvaye 'pi narake ghore tasmād enāṃ sthitiṃ bhajet
